credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Georgia O'Keeffe being helped out of a pontoon raft by Steve Porter. Doris Bry and Kenny Ross (man with cap), guide from Moab, Utah, would take John Wesley Powell's route and Norman Neville's route. This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River'.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Exiting Raft
